items.headline: Kalen DeBoer discusses expectations for Bama vs. South Carolina
items.description: DeBoer describes Keelon Russell's strengths and areas of improvement opportunities as he discusses his expectations for the No. 13 Crimson Tide against the Gamecocks.

items.headline: Roman Harper stresses need for Bama to have fresh mentality vs. Texas A&M
items.description: Harper reflects on the No. 13 Crimson Tide's performance in Week 7 as he emphasizes the importance of putting the loss behind them and focusing on their matchup vs. the Aggies.

items.headline: Kris Budden eases Alabama panic ahead of matchup vs. Texas A&M
items.description: Budden joins The Paul Finebaum Show to preview the showdown between the Crimson Tide and Aggies while explaining how Alabama is staying calm through rough stretch.

items.headline: Taylor Zarzour analyzes struggles for No. 19 Texas, No. 13 Alabama
items.description: With offensive problems plaguing both the Longhorns and the Crimson Tide, ESPN's Taylor Zarzour explains on SEC This Morning what each team must improve to avoid those issues.
